purpose: Scoped rollback guard for the Central-Pacific/GALVANIC re-audit while preserving unrelated 1943H2 settlements conditionally.

conditionally_retained: Royal Navy divergence and Dodecanese settlement
China/Chindwin facts not dependent on changed Pacific shared assets
scoped_reopen.dependency_trip_rule: Reopen a retained theater only if the GALVANIC re-audit changes a shared hull/air-group/escort/fuel/repair/shipping/command allocation enough to alter an explicit prior assumption.

carrier_guard.rule: Every deck requires hull/engine/deck state, ready air group, qualified aircrew, deck/maintenance fatigue, spares, fuel/ordnance, escort, speed/wind/recovery geometry and assignment. Do not treat secondary decks as absent or as equal fast fleet carriers.

fatigue_guard.rule: Carry fatigue/readiness from 1943-10-01 through mobilization. Resolve aircrew, deck crew, maintenance staff, surface crews, aircraft/engine hours and repair backlog; no D-Day snapshot reset.

sensor_guard.rule: Compatible-band Japanese passive warning may precede US weapon-quality tracking. US SG/CIC/fighter-direction advantages remain and may dominate later stages. Apply unit/band/date distribution explicitly.

night_surface_guard.rule: Night confidence may be higher in trained surviving units because ESM and repeatable torpedo doctrine reduce total-surprise risk. Confidence changes GO/NO-GO, battle preparation and willingness for a limited torpedo probe; it is not a free accuracy multiplier or license for a prolonged SG/CIC gunfight.

supersession_note: Retained for provenance only. Current execution uses the 1944-01-01 strategic frontier plus CHECKPOINT_1943-11-23T00_BRANCH_B_GALVANIC_REAUDIT_v001 for the reopened dependency.
